entries.effect: a subclass of NSPersistentContainer, so everything the container does on the device it does here: the model is found by name, the store descriptions are built, the stores are loaded and the view context and background contexts work as they do on the plain container. Nothing is mirrored to CloudKit and no record ever leaves the device; the first container made says so once in the log
entries.source: the CoreData headers of SDK 16.4 for the declarations; the host's own CoreData for the value of the option key, read at run time; nothing of a release was read for the mirroring, as no release this port runs on has CloudKit
